# D-STAR header bursts produced by the MMDVM firmware's own encoder (DStarTX::txHeader,
# CRC by MMDVMHost CCRC::addCCITT161), compiled verbatim outside this repo.
# Fields: name, the 41 header bytes as hex (CRC included), then the on-air bits in
# transmission order: the 16-bit frame sync 0xEA 0xA6 sent LSB first, four zero bits,
# and the 660-bit FEC section (CDStarTX::process, writeByte sends each byte LSB first).
